messages:
Maya Patel: heads-up — I'm kicking off FP8 kernel enable experiments on H100 + L40S for 13B and 70B. Logging bakeoff notes here. any immediate gotchas?
Cheng Wu: high level: FP8 kernels need CUDA 12.2+ and the newer cuBLAS/cuDNN builds. watch accum precision — fp16 accum with fp8 compute sometimes produces NaNs on certain matmuls.
Olivia Grant: quick numbers from my local runs (13B, seq512, batch=1): AWQ int4 vs GPTQ int4 diff and FP8 exec perf. AWQ int4 MMLU -0.6% vs fp16 baseline, GPTQ int4 -1.3%. FP8 execution (no weight quant) gave ~no quality regression but big perf win on H100.
Samir Rao: can you paste latency/throughput?
Olivia Grant: 13B @ seq512/batch1: fp16 latency ~240ms, FP8 kernel latency ~200ms (~1.2x). tokens/s: fp16 ~420, fp8 ~510. MMLU delta vs fp16 baseline ~-0.4% (within noise).
Maya Patel: what about 70B? that's the scary one for us.
Leah Kim: 70B is trickier. On H100 we saw ~1.15x throughput with FP8 but intermittent NaNs in attention softmax when KV cache is contiguous. Setting USE_MIXED_ACCUM=1 avoided NaNs but added ~+5% latency.
Cheng Wu: L40S behaved differently — FP8 kernel crashed on fused matmul when inputs came from layernorm with tiny variances. Workaround: per-layer fallback to fp16 matmul for layers matching pattern. We added a "fallback_layers.json" and pinned those layers to fp16.
Olivia Grant: also note AWQ-int4 + FP8 execution mismatch: AWQ expects int4 dequant packing; running AWQ weights through the FP8-packed kernel without conversion produced garbage (2-3% drop / hallucination). Need a conversion step (awq -> fp8-packed) or run AWQ through our INT execution path.
Samir Rao: do we have a deployment profile example that does canary + fallback?
Olivia Grant: yes — pasted minimal profile: 
```
{
  "route": "model/v2/13b-fp8",
  "canary": {
    "capacity": "5%",
    "pool": "h100-dedicated-canary"
  },
  "fallback_policy": [
    {"reason": "nan_or_timeout", "route": "model/v2/13b-int8"},
    {"reason": "high_perplexity", "route": "model/v2/13b-fp16"}
  ]
}
```
Keep it simple: canary on H100 pool, fallback to int8 then fp16.
Maya Patel: what's the recommended ops/flags for runtime to reduce mixed-precision pitfalls?
Cheng Wu: checklist: 
- CUDA>=12.2
- use patched cuBLAS/cuDNN builds we tested
- env: `export USE_FP8_KERNEL=1` and `export USE_MIXED_ACCUM=1` if you see NaNs
- per-layer fallback table when layernorm->matmul combos cause instability
- re-pack AWQ/GPTQ weights for FP8 execution (do not mix pack formats)
Samir Rao: how did we measure quality? what eval harness?
Olivia Grant: used mmlueval v2 harness, Lambada and a short held-out prompt set (internal). Summary table: 
- 13B fp16 baseline: MMLU 41.2, Lambada acc 38.5, ppl baseline=7.8
- 13B FP8 exec: MMLU 40.8 (-0.4), Lambada 38.2 (-0.3), ppl=7.9 (+0.1)
- 13B AWQ int4: MMLU 40.6 (-0.6), Lambada 38.1 (-0.4)
- 70B fp16 baseline: MMLU 52.3, FP8 exec: MMLU 51.4 (-0.9) and occasional NaNs without MIXED_ACCUM
Leah Kim: operational notes — on L40S we needed to pin `--no-fused-layernorm` in the runtime for stability (this trades a few ms latency but avoids crashes). Also driver on L40S required micro-patch from infra (I dropped a link in the infra ticket).
Maya Patel: next steps — we should: (1) spin up a canary 13B FP8 on dedicated H100 pool, (2) generate regression alerts in Console for perplexity > +1.0 or MMLU drop > 1.0, (3) add an awq->fp8 packing job to model onboarding, (4) document per-layer fallback patterns.
infra-bot: deploy job queued: canary h100-dedicated-2 -> model/v2/13b-fp8; estimated start in 30m. (job id: deploy-6621)
Leah Kim: I'll add the fallback_layers.json + sample conversion script to the model onboarding repo and open a PR.
Samir Rao: and I'll wire a canary alert: if avg perplexity over 1h window > +1.0 vs baseline, send page to oncall and create Optimize regression.
Maya Patel: perfect. if anyone hits a crash paste the runtime stderr here (stack traces help). thanks all.
